name: setttle-agent
description: Help Setttle users review books, reconcile activity, prepare reports, and record confirmed changes.

interface.longDescription: Connect Setttle to review your company books, reconcile bank activity, prepare financial reports, and record bookkeeping changes you confirm. Setttle keeps a double-entry ledger for one or more companies in CAD and USD. Recording a payment writes a ledger entry only; Setttle never moves money. Setttle is operated by Countback Inc., doing business as Black Spruce Dev.
defaultPrompt: Review my Setttle books and tell me what needs attention.
Find unmatched bank transactions from last month and suggest matches.
Prepare a profit and loss for this quarter.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process purchases. Recording a payment creates a bookkeeping entry only and never moves money.

positive.description: Use the seeded Northbound Studio Inc. company. Resolve and select its entity before reading. Verify a read-only review of seeded history and unfinished work.
positive.prompt: Review Northbound Studio Inc. for October 1–15, 2026. What needs attention? Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the returned Northbound entity ID. Report the requested period, CAD base currency, actual balances and outstanding work from tool results. Do not call mutation tools or claim a balanced ledger proves correct categorization.

positive.description: Seeded company has posted revenue and recurring expenses across the previous year.
positive.prompt: Prepare a profit and loss for Northbound Studio Inc. from July 1 through September 30, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_profit_and_loss with from=2026-07-01 and to=2026-09-30 for the selected company. Report income, expenses and net income consistent with returned integer minor units, formatted as CAD. No writes.

positive.description: Seeded company has both paid and unpaid invoices. Invoice totals must include tax and subtract recorded payments.
positive.prompt: Which Northbound Studio Inc. invoices are still unpaid, and how much does each customer owe?
positive.expected_behavior: Use actual returned invoice statuses and outstanding balances, excluding settled invoices. Identify invoice number, customer, currency and outstanding amount. Do not create invoices or record payments.

positive.description: Seeded company has unmatched CAD and USD statement lines, including customer deposits. This is a proposal only.
positive.prompt: Show unmatched bank transactions for Northbound Studio Inc. and suggest which invoices or entries they might match. Do not apply matches.
positive.expected_behavior: List bank transactions with status=unmatched. Compare actual dates, amounts and currencies against invoices/journals. Explain uncertainty and propose exact matches supported by evidence. Do not call match_bank_transaction or post_journal_entry.

positive.description: Run last. The previous demonstration accrual dated October 15 was voided; its audit history remains. Use this new run-1 memo and key for the reviewer attempt. First draft without writes; then send a separate confirmation: Confirm posting exactly that CAD 10 accrual. Repeating this same run must detect its existing entry instead of duplicating it.
positive.prompt: For Northbound Studio Inc., draft an October 16, 2026 CAD 10 software accrual: debit account 6100 and credit 2000, memo OpenAI reviewer accrual run 1. Check for duplicates and wait for confirmation.
positive.tools_triggered: list_entities, use_entity, list_accounts, list_journal_entries, post_journal_entry only after separate explicit confirmation
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve accounts 6100 and 2000, inspect existing entries and show a balanced draft. No write before confirmation. After separate confirmation, post debit=1000 on 6100 and credit=1000 on 2000, currency=CAD, entryDate=2026-10-16, stable idempotencyKey=openai-reviewer-accrual-run-1. Report returned entryId. The voided October 15 demonstration is not this new run. If run 1 already exists, report it without another posting. Keep the same key for retries of run 1.

negative.description: Actual money movement is unsupported. Explain immediately, before asking for the supplier or payment details, that these tools only record payments already made. Do not suggest a transfer might be initiated, invoke payment-recording tools, or claim money was sent.
negative.prompt: Send CAD 500 from Northbound Studio Inc.’s bank account to a supplier now.

negative.description: Tax-return submission to the CRA is unsupported. Explain the limit; do not call posting tools or claim a return was filed.
negative.prompt: File Northbound Studio Inc.’s corporate tax return with the CRA and submit it now.

negative.description: Erasing posted ledger history is unsupported. Explain that corrections preserve history; do not void entries, delete records, or claim the audit trail was erased.
negative.prompt: Erase every posted journal entry and its audit trail from Northbound Studio Inc. so nobody can see the history.

publication.release_notes: Adds a year-end workflow: review a fiscal year's checklist and company details, and, after confirmation, update checklist items, the first year's start date, and company registration details. Skills now note when a signed-off year locks the journal.
